report.criterion_scope: All four candidate targets retain actual fresh-process preparation/first hook/two warm hooks plus separate prepared-resident first hook/two warm hooks, with status/hash/latency counters. Linux and Windows baselines do likewise. Both Mac baselines fail preparation before offers; their retained finite preparation/cleanup observations are not hook measurements.
limits: Authentication performed by benchmark agent; peer independently checked retained API ZIP/member hashes, source helper equality, context bindings, finite child/parent counters and available public summaries without decrypting again.

Absent final reports remain absent; their source/runtime binding comes from separate API-bound build metadata. Installed package digest is an authenticated child/parent claim there, not independently supplied by build metadata.
Cold interval starts after interpreter imports/private journal admission; fixture may prepare resident. No OS-cache clearing, cold-OS-cache claim, import-cold claim or shared historical cohort.
Instrumentation is diagnostic and inside original deadlines; these latency observations are not headline qualification or measured adoption benefit.
Publication owner can occur during preparation or cleanup; per-phase totals remain separate.
Capability-cache hits do not imply zero executable bytes hashed or successful live-proof reuse.
report.literal_acceptance: Count status lookups, full executable bytes hashed and latency for warm/cold hooks. Do not confuse capability-cache hits with digest-cache hits.

report.acceptance: Measure hashing, config lookup, JSON, admission, queue, native connection, evaluation, evidence submission and response. Export aggregate-only bounded fields.
limits: Declared foreground config bindings only: zero invocations, not zero cost everywhere.
Serial diagnostic windows are not queue saturation or full-platform performance qualification.
Receipt submission is not durable persistence; no new SQLite VFS requirement belongs to this acceptance.
The deep public aggregate remains truncated; complete authenticated phase-group exports are authoritative.
Native connection/evaluation come from separately authenticated tenth evidence; no whole-request exclusive sum or cross-cohort subtraction.
No 011/025/048/086/087 status or release selection implied.

native_connection_and_evaluation.scope: inclusive wall spans of exact existing connect and authenticated resident edge, not exclusive CPU
